findings.title: Customer wants more capacity on reactive-dog rehab coaching track for supervisor cohort
findings.description: Simone says the reactive-dog rehabilitation coaching track has been a lifeline for shop-floor supervisors who adopted high-energy rescue dogs, and that she'd want more of it, possibly as a reason to grow seats sooner. Priya frames this as a mid-term seat add tagged to the supervisor group on the existing agreement, not a new product capability. This is praise for an existing offering plus a request for more seats/capacity, not a defect in or missing feature of the BetterBark product itself.
findings.quote: The reactive-dog rehabilitation track has been the workhorse. Our shop floor supervisors, the ones who adopted high-energy rescues
findings.severity_reason: No product defect or capability gap identified; this is positive feedback tied to a commercial seat-expansion conversation, with no engineering-actionable ask.
findings.match_note: No catalogue issue matches; existing coaching track already delivers the value described, and the ask is for more seats, not a product change.
